headline: Utilities Break California Lobbying Record Under Newsom While Former Aides Lead Utility-Backed Wildfire Coalition, Says Consumer Watchdog
summary: California's three largest investor-owned utilities — Pacific Gas & Electric (PG&E), Southern California Edison (Edison), and Sempra Energy (Sempra) — have already mounted the most expensive lobbying campaign in state history, spending $16.7 million lobbying Governor Gavin Newsom's administration, the Legislature and state regulators through the first six reporting quarters of the 2025–2026 legislative session, according to new disclosures released today.
